content_policy: Clinical classification of scripted game dialogue. Every player line is identified by info_key + topic and a neutral summary of at most 8 words; no line text and no NPC reply text is reproduced (the harness resolves the text from the index by info_key). Paraphrases are the tester's own plain wording.
scoring: real lrgDlgAnswerWant (want=1 fast path, parsed from the emit log) and lrgDlgDecideEntry (her T-key) on a byte-identical temp copy of glue/server/lorerim_glue (lrg_dialogue.php md5 407c4d60f6c6474bc80879a8a8454ffd, lrg_prompt_index.php md5 bf4d59d236f452244df16030abb4e833, copied 2026-09-24), lists decorated by lrgPromptLookup + lrgDlgDecorateEntries, harness adapted from pt19x-merge/recheck.php; work in %TEMP%\lrg_test\pt19x-db\. via: pick/explicit/single/auto = fast path on his words; park = fast match on a commit, she asks once; model = only her T-key would pick it; park-tkey = her T-key parks; wrong = a sibling is clicked; none = nothing.
scene_check: No DB beat is spoken in a journal-quest scene: 60 DB SCEN records in Skyrim.esm and 8 in the DB mods (Innocence Lost QE 4, Destroy the DB QE 1, Vittoria's Alternate Wedding 3) were read; none has a player-dialogue action (PTOP/NTOP/NETO/QTOP). All DB conversations are forcegreets or normal talk, so scene=false throughout and nothing is read-only on the first evening.

legend.summary: neutral <=8-word description of the player line; the line itself is looked up by info_key
legend.layer.form: layer_line = the index layer line; parent_links = one INFO per topic linked from the parent player line (what the engine shows); siblings = hand-built from the quest rows (the index line is a twin); root = top-level rows of that NPC at that stage; greeting = reached from the NPC greeting with no index layer; index_layer = the index line that carries the same norms
legend.fx: only where the fragment was read (loose .pex, USSEP BSA, Skyrim - Misc.bsa); names shortened from the Papyrus disassembly
legend.near_miss.ok: false when the fast path clicks the target, clicks a sibling or parks the target
